ideas.title: Following the Money: COVID Fraud Schemes in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent convictions and ongoing investigations into COVID fraud schemes in Minnesota, including the pilfering of funds meant for underserved children.
questions: How much money was pilfered in the COVID fraud schemes?
Who was involved in the schemes?
ideas.insight: This story idea is significant because it highlights the need for accountability and transparency in the handling of federal funds. By following the money, we can uncover the extent of the fraud schemes and identify those responsible.
